title: Hanuma narrates the story of
introduction: Hanuma narrates the story of Rama, who on command from his father, went on exile to Dandaka forest along with Seetha, who was later borne away by Ravana through the sky over Rishyamuka mountain. Hanuma adds that Rama, while searching for Seetha at Mount Rishyamuka, happened to meet Sugreeva and made friendship with him. Hanuma also tells the story about Rama installing Sugreeva in the throne, after killing Vali and about Sugreeva promising Rama to get Seetha searched. Celebrating the glory of Rama, Hanuma points out to Ravana that if he wished to survive he should give back Seetha to Rama and that he should be prepared for the worst if on the other hand he refuses to do so.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे एकपङ्चशः सर्गः
Thus completes 51st Chapter of Sundara Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
तम् समीक्ष्य महासत्त्वम् सत्त्ववान् हारि सत्तमः |
वाक्यम् अर्थवत् अव्यग्रः तम् उवाच दश आननम्
verses.iast:
tam samīkṣya mahāsattvam sattvavān hāri sattamaḥ |
vākyam arthavat avyagraḥ tam uvāca daśa ānanam
verses.translation: Seeing that highly energetic Ravana, the courageous Hanuma coolly spoke to him the following meaningful words:

verses.devanagari:
अहम् सुग्रीव संदेशात् इह प्राप्तः तव आलयम् |
राक्षस इन्द्र हरि ईशः त्वाम् भ्राता कुशलम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
aham sugrīva saṃdeśāt iha prāptaḥ tava ālayam |
rākṣasa indra hari īśaḥ tvām bhrātā kuśalam abravīt
verses.translation: "O king of demons! By the command of Sugreeva, I came here to your abode. Sugreeva, the Lord of monkeys, your brother, asked me to enquire about your welfare.

verses.devanagari:
भ्रातुः शृणु समादेशम् सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः |
धर्म अर्थ उपहितम् वाक्यम् इह च अमुत्र च क्षमम्
verses.iast:
bhrātuḥ śṛṇu samādeśam sugrīvasya mahātmanaḥ |
dharma artha upahitam vākyam iha ca amutra ca kṣamam
verses.translation: "Hear the righteous and meaningful words, as a following advice, of the high-souled Sugreeva, your brother, conducive to good in the world as well as in the other world."

glosses.meaning: as also endowed with righteousness and meaningfulness.

verses.devanagari:
राजा दशरथो नाम रथ कुन्जर वाजिमान् |
पिता इव बन्धुः लोकस्य सुर ईश्वर सम द्युतिः
verses.iast:
rājā daśaratho nāma ratha kunjara vājimān |
pitā iva bandhuḥ lokasya sura īśvara sama dyutiḥ
verses.translation: "There was a king named Dasaratha, having chariots, elephants and horses, like a father to the people and endowed with a splendour equal to that of Indra the lord of celestials."

glosses.meaning: and possessing a splendour equal to that of Indra the Lord of celestials.

verses.devanagari:
ज्येष्ठः तस्य महाबाहुः पुत्रः प्रिय करः प्रभुः |
पितुः निदेशान् निष्क्रान्तः प्रविष्टो दण्डका वनम्
लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा सीतया च अपि भार्यया |
रामो नाम महातेजा धर्म्यम् पन्थानम् आश्रितः
verses.iast:
jyeṣṭhaḥ tasya mahābāhuḥ putraḥ priya karaḥ prabhuḥ |
pituḥ nideśān niṣkrāntaḥ praviṣṭo daṇḍakā vanam
lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā sītayā ca api bhāryayā |
rāmo nāma mahātejā dharmyam panthānam āśritaḥ
verses.translation: "His eldest son named Rama, having mighty arms, a bestower of affection and our lord, by the command of his father, abiding in a righteous path, went out on exile and entered a forest called Dandaka along with Lakshmana his brother and Seetha his wife."

verses.devanagari:
तस्य भार्या वने नष्टा सीता पतिम् अनुव्रता |
वैदेहस्य सुता राज्ञो जनकस्य महात्मनः
verses.iast:
tasya bhāryā vane naṣṭā sītā patim anuvratā |
vaidehasya sutā rājño janakasya mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: "Seetha, wife of Rama, devoted to her husband and daughter of the high-souled king, named Janaka, the head of Videha kingdom, got lost in the forest."

verses.devanagari:
स मार्गमाणः ताम् देवीम् राज पुत्रः सह अनुजः |
ऋश्यमूकम् अनुप्राप्तः सुग्रीवेण च सम्गतः
verses.iast:
sa mārgamāṇaḥ tām devīm rāja putraḥ saha anujaḥ |
ṛśyamūkam anuprāptaḥ sugrīveṇa ca samgataḥ
verses.translation: "That prince, Rama together with his brother, searching that lady, reached Mount Rishyamuka and happened to meet Sugreeva."

verses.devanagari:
तस्य तेन प्रतिज्ञातम् सीतायाः परिमार्गणम् |
सुग्रीवस्य अपि रामेण हरि राज्यम् निवेदितम्
verses.iast:
tasya tena pratijñātam sītāyāḥ parimārgaṇam |
sugrīvasya api rāmeṇa hari rājyam niveditam
verses.translation: "While Sugreeva promised Rama to get Seetha searched, Rama too promised to get the kingdom of monkeys to Sugreeva."

verses.devanagari:
ततः तेन मृधे हत्वा राज पुत्रेण वालिनम् |
सुग्रीवः स्थापितो राज्ये हरि ऋक्षाणाम् गण ईश्वरः
verses.iast:
tataḥ tena mṛdhe hatvā rāja putreṇa vālinam |
sugrīvaḥ sthāpito rājye hari ṛkṣāṇām gaṇa īśvaraḥ
verses.translation: "Thereafter, killing Vali in a combat, Rama installed Sugreeva on the throne as a lord of that troop monkeys and bears."

glosses.meaning: as a Lord of that troop.

verses.devanagari:
त्वया विज्ञातपूर्वश्च वाली वानरपुङ्गवः |
रामेण निहतः संख्ये शरेणैकेन वानरः
verses.iast:
tvayā vijJṇātapūrvaśca vālī vānarapuṇ^gavaḥ |
rāmeṇa nihataḥ saṅkhye śareṇaikena vānaraḥ
verses.translation: "You may indeed know Vali, the foremost among monkeys, previously. Rama killed that Vali with a single arrow in battle."

verses.devanagari:
स सीता मार्गणे व्यग्रः सुग्रीवः सत्य सम्गरः |
हरीन् सम्प्रेषयामास दिशः सर्वा हरि ईश्वरः
verses.iast:
sa sītā mārgaṇe vyagraḥ sugrīvaḥ satya samgaraḥ |
harīn sampreṣayāmāsa diśaḥ sarvā hari īśvaraḥ
verses.translation: "Sugreeva, the lord of monkeys, true to his promise, was intent on searching for Seetha and sent his monkeys to all directions."

verses.devanagari:
ताम् हरीणाम् सहस्राणि शतानि नियुतानि च |
दिक्षु सर्वासु मार्गन्ते अधः च उपरि च अम्बरे
verses.iast:
tām harīṇām sahasrāṇi śatāni niyutāni ca |
dikṣu sarvāsu mārgante adhaḥ ca upari ca ambare
verses.translation: "Hundreds, thousands and lakhs of monkeys are searching for her in all quarters, as also below and above in the sky."

verses.devanagari:
वैनतेय समाः केचित् केचित् तत्र अनिल उपमाः |
असम्ग गतयः शीघ्रा हरि वीरा महाबलाः
verses.iast:
vainateya samāḥ kecit kecit tatra anila upamāḥ |
asamga gatayaḥ śīghrā hari vīrā mahābalāḥ
verses.translation: "Among those monkeys, some mighty and virile monkeys are similar to Garuda the eagle. Some are like wind, swiftly going with an unhindered movement."

glosses.meaning: are like Garuda the eagle. kechit = some

verses.devanagari:
अहम् तु हनुमान् नाम मारुतस्य औरसः सुतः |
सीतायाः तु कृते तूर्णम् शत योजनम् आयतम्
समुद्रम् लन्घयित्वा एव ताम् दिदृक्षुः इह आगतः |
verses.iast:
aham tu hanumān nāma mārutasya aurasaḥ sutaḥ |
sītāyāḥ tu kṛte tūrṇam śata yojanam āyatam
samudram langhayitvā eva tām didṛkṣuḥ iha āgataḥ |
verses.translation: "I am, however, an own son of wind-god and named as Hanuma. I came here even by crossing quickly the ocean, which is a hundred yojanas (or eight hundred miles) wide for the sake of Seetha and wishing to see her."

glosses.meaning: which is a hundred yojanas (or eight hundred miles) wide

verses.devanagari:
भ्रमता च मया दृष्टा गृहे ते जनकात्मजा
तत् भवान् दृष्ट धर्म अर्थः तपः कृत परिग्रहः |
पर दारान् महाप्राज्ञ न उपरोद्धुम् त्वम् अर्हसि
verses.iast:
bhramatā ca mayā dṛṣṭā gṛhe te janakātmajā
tat bhavān dṛṣṭa dharma arthaḥ tapaḥ kṛta parigrahaḥ |
para dārān mahāprājña na uparoddhum tvam arhasi
verses.translation: "While strolling around in the city of Lanka, I found Seetha in your abode. You know about religious merit and wealth. You performed and mastered the austerities. That is why, you ought not besiege the wife of another, O great intellectual!"

glosses.meaning: learnt about religious merit and wealth
and performed and mastered the austerities

verses.devanagari:
न हि धर्म विरुद्धेषु बह्व् अपायेषु कर्मसु |
मूल घातिषु सज्जन्ते बुद्धिमन्तो भवत् विधाः
verses.iast:
na hi dharma viruddheṣu bahv apāyeṣu karmasu |
mūla ghātiṣu sajjante buddhimanto bhavat vidhāḥ
verses.translation: "Intellectuals like you indeed are not engrossed in acts, which are antagonistic to righteousness, which are attended with many dangers and which even ruin the doer at the roots."

glosses.meaning: which are attended with many dangers
and which ruin doer at the roots.

verses.devanagari:
कः च लक्ष्मण मुक्तानाम् राम कोप अनुवर्तिनाम् |
शराणाम् अग्रतः स्थातुम् शक्तो देव असुरेष्व् अपि
verses.iast:
kaḥ ca lakṣmaṇa muktānām rāma kopa anuvartinām |
śarāṇām agrataḥ sthātum śakto deva asureṣv api
verses.translation: "Who is capable even among celestials and demons, to withstand the arrows discharged by Lakshmana, in the wake of the fury of Rama?

glosses.meaning: discharged by LakSmaNamuktaanaam = discharged by Lakshmana
in the wake of the fury of Rama?

verses.devanagari:
न च अपि त्रिषु लोकेषु राजन् विद्येत कश्चन |
राघवस्य व्यलीकम् यः कृत्वा सुखम् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.iast:
na ca api triṣu lokeṣu rājan vidyeta kaścana |
rāghavasya vyalīkam yaḥ kṛtvā sukham avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: "O king! No one is known in the three worlds, who have gained happiness, by doing harm to Rama."

verses.devanagari:
तत् त्रिकाल हितम् वाक्यम् धर्म्यम् अर्थ अनुबन्धि च |
मन्यस्व नर देवाय जानकी प्रतिदीयताम्
verses.iast:
tat trikāla hitam vākyam dharmyam artha anubandhi ca |
manyasva nara devāya jānakī pratidīyatām
verses.translation: "That is why, accede to my words, which are beneficial for all the three divisions of time (viz. the past, present and future), resulting in affluence and respectability as well. Let Seetha be restored to Rama."

glosses.meaning: which are beneficial for all the three times
and resulting in affluence and respectability janakii = 9let) Seetha

verses.devanagari:
दृष्टा हि इयम् मया देवी लब्धम् यत् इह दुर्लभम् |
उत्तरम् कर्म यत् शेषम् निमित्तम् तत्र राघवः
verses.iast:
dṛṣṭā hi iyam mayā devī labdham yat iha durlabham |
uttaram karma yat śeṣam nimittam tatra rāghavaḥ
verses.translation: "I beheld Seetha, the princess. The audience of Seetha is difficult to be achieved and it is obtained here. It is for Rama there to decide his remaining task of future consequence."

verses.devanagari:
लक्षिता इयम् मया सीता तथा शोक परायणा |
गृह्य याम् न अभिजानासि पन्च आस्याम् इव पन्नगीम्
verses.iast:
lakṣitā iyam mayā sītā tathā śoka parāyaṇā |
gṛhya yām na abhijānāsi panca āsyām iva pannagīm
verses.translation: "Capturing Seetha, whom you do not recognize as a five-hooded female serpent in your abode, has been found by me in that manner, and wholly given over to sorrow."

glosses.meaning: you are not able to recognize

verses.devanagari:
न इयम् जरयितुम् शक्या सासुरैः अमरैः अपि |
विष संसृष्टम् अत्यर्थम् भुक्तम् अन्नम् इव ओजसा
verses.iast:
na iyam jarayitum śakyā sāsuraiḥ amaraiḥ api |
viṣa saṃsṛṣṭam atyartham bhuktam annam iva ojasā
verses.translation: "She is incapable of being devoured with one's might even by celestials and demons, any more than food mixed with abundant poison could be digested with one's digestive power, if consumed."

glosses.meaning: is in capable of being consumed.

verses.devanagari:
तपः सम्ताप लब्धः ते यो अयम् धर्म परिग्रहः |
न स नाशयितुम् न्याय्य आत्म प्राण परिग्रहः
verses.iast:
tapaḥ samtāpa labdhaḥ te yo ayam dharma parigrahaḥ |
na sa nāśayitum nyāyya ātma prāṇa parigrahaḥ
verses.translation: "It is not proper for you to lose your exceptional longevity and that fortune which is an outcome of your virtue, both of which have been acquired by you through the practice of austerities."

glosses.meaning: capacity to preserve your life (for exceptional longevity)
is an outcome of your virtue
both of which have been acquired by you through the practice of austerities.

verses.devanagari:
अवध्यताम् तपोभिः याम् भवान् समनुपश्यति |
आत्मनः सासुरैः देवैः हेतुः तत्र अपि अयम् महान्
verses.iast:
avadhyatām tapobhiḥ yām bhavān samanupaśyati |
ātmanaḥ sāsuraiḥ devaiḥ hetuḥ tatra api ayam mahān
verses.translation: "You may be thinking that you are immune from death from demons and celestials, because of your austerities. But your opinion in that matter is not correct, on account of the following reason.

verses.devanagari:
सुग्रीवो न हि देवो अयम् न असुरो न च मानुषः |
न दानवो न गन्धर्वो न यक्षो न च पन्नगः
तस्मात् प्राण परित्राणम् कथम् राजन् करिष्यसि |
verses.iast:
sugrīvo na hi devo ayam na asuro na ca mānuṣaḥ |
na dānavo na gandharvo na yakṣo na ca pannagaḥ
tasmāt prāṇa paritrāṇam katham rājan kariṣyasi |
verses.translation: "This Sugreeva is indeed neither a god, nor Asura the chief of evil spirits nor a demon nor a child of Danu the demon, nor Gandharva the celestial musician nor Yaksha the semi-divine being nor pannaga the serpent-demon. O King! How do you protect your life from him?"

glosses.meaning: nor Asura the chief of evil spirits
nor a child of Danu the demons

verses.devanagari:
न तु धर्म उपसम्हारम् अधर्म फल सम्हितम्
तत् एव फलम् अन्वेति धर्मः च अधर्म नाशनः |
verses.iast:
na tu dharma upasamhāram adharma phala samhitam
tat eva phalam anveti dharmaḥ ca adharma nāśanaḥ |
verses.translation: "The fruit of righteousness does not exist together with the result of unrighteousness (eventhough he practices virtue). That consequence of unrighteousness alone follows him. Righteousness in abundance destroys unrighteousness."

glosses.meaning: close by the result of unrighteousness

verses.devanagari:
प्राप्तम् धर्म फलम् तावत् भवता न अत्र संशयः
फलम् अस्य अपि अधर्मस्य क्षिप्रम् एव प्रपत्स्यसे |
verses.iast:
prāptam dharma phalam tāvat bhavatā na atra saṃśayaḥ
phalam asya api adharmasya kṣipram eva prapatsyase |
verses.translation: "You already obtained the fruit of virtue till now. There is no doubt about it. In no time, you will obtain the fruit of unrighteousness also."

verses.devanagari:
जन स्थान वधम् बुद्ध्वा बुद्ध्वा वालि वधम् तथा
राम सुग्रीव सख्यम् च बुध्यस्व हितम् आत्मनः |
verses.iast:
jana sthāna vadham buddhvā buddhvā vāli vadham tathā
rāma sugrīva sakhyam ca budhyasva hitam ātmanaḥ |
verses.translation: "Recognizing the killing of demons in the forest of Janasthana, about the killing of Vali and about the friendship between Rama and Sugreeva, realize your own interest."

glosses.meaning: the killing of demons in Janasthana-forest
and about the friendship between Rama and Sugreeva

verses.devanagari:
कामम् खल्व् अहम् अपि एकः सवाजि रथ कुन्जराम्
लन्काम् नाशयितुम् शक्तः तस्य एष तु विनिश्चयः |
verses.iast:
kāmam khalv aham api ekaḥ savāji ratha kunjarām
lankām nāśayitum śaktaḥ tasya eṣa tu viniścayaḥ |
verses.translation: "I am indeed, even alone, undoubtedly, destroying Lanka, along with its horses, chariots and elephants. However, this is not in accordance with the resolution of Rama."

verses.devanagari:
रामेण हि प्रतिज्ञातम् हरि ऋक्ष गण सम्निधौ
उत्सादनम् अमित्राणाम् सीता यैः तु प्रधर्षिता |
verses.iast:
rāmeṇa hi pratijñātam hari ṛkṣa gaṇa samnidhau
utsādanam amitrāṇām sītā yaiḥ tu pradharṣitā |
verses.translation: "For, Rama, indeed, promised in the presence of troops of monkeys and bears, about the extermination of enemies, by whom Seetha was actually laid violent hands upon."

glosses.meaning: in the presence of troops of monkeys and bears
was actually laid violent hands upon.

verses.devanagari:
अपकुर्वन् हि रामस्य साक्षात् अपि पुरम् दरः
न सुखम् प्राप्नुयात् अन्यः किम् पुनः त्वत् विधो जनः |
verses.iast:
apakurvan hi rāmasya sākṣāt api puram daraḥ
na sukham prāpnuyāt anyaḥ kim punaḥ tvat vidho janaḥ |
verses.translation: "Even Indra the Lord of celestials, in person, cannot attain happiness if he does any harm to Rama. How much move to another person like you?"

glosses.meaning: even Indra the Lord of celestials

verses.devanagari:
याम् सीता इति अभिजानासि या इयम् तिष्ठति ते वशे
काल रात्री इति ताम् विद्धि सर्व लन्का विनाशिनीम् |
verses.iast:
yām sītā iti abhijānāsi yā iyam tiṣṭhati te vaśe
kāla rātrī iti tām viddhi sarva lankā vināśinīm |
verses.translation: "Know her, whom you recognize as Seetha and who stays in your captivity, to be none else than Kalaratri (the goddess presiding over and responsible for dissolution), who can destroy the entire Lanka."

glosses.meaning: to be none else than kalaratri (the goddess presiding over and responsible for universal dissolution)
who can destroy the entire Lanka.

verses.devanagari:
तत् अलम् काल पाशेन सीता विग्रह रूपिणा
स्वयम् स्कन्ध अवसक्तेन क्षमम् आत्मनि चिन्त्यताम् |
verses.iast:
tat alam kāla pāśena sītā vigraha rūpiṇā
svayam skandha avasaktena kṣamam ātmani cintyatām |
verses.translation: "Therefore, have it enough of this noose of death, in the form of Seetha's personality, which has been placed by yourself around your neck. Think well of your safety."

glosses.meaning: in the form of Seetha's personality
which has been placed by yourself around your neck

verses.devanagari:
सीतायाः तेजसा दग्धाम् राम कोप प्रपीडिताम्
दह्यमनाम् इमाम् पश्य पुरीम् साट्ट प्रतोलिकाम् |
verses.iast:
sītāyāḥ tejasā dagdhām rāma kopa prapīḍitām
dahyamanām imām paśya purīm sāṭṭa pratolikām |
verses.translation: "See; (in the immediate future), this city of Lanka, burnt away by the effulgence of Seetha and the City too being scorched with its markets and main streets, afflicted by the wrath of Rama."

glosses.meaning: with its markets and main streets
afflicted by the wrath of Rama.

verses.devanagari:
स्वानि मित्राणि मन्त्रींश्च ज्ञातीन् भ्रातृन् सुतान् हितान्
भोगान् दारांश्च लङ्काम् च मा विनाशमुपानय |
verses.iast:
svāni mitrāṇi mantrīṃśca jJṇātīn bhrātṛn sutān hitān
bhogān dārāṃśca laṇ^kām ca mā vināśamupānaya |
verses.translation: "Do not lead to extermination your own friends, counsellors, kinsmen, brothers, sons, well-wishers, enjoyments, wives and Lanka."

verses.devanagari:
सत्यम् राक्षसराजेन्द्र शृणुष्व वचनम् मम
रामदासस्य दूतस्य वानरस्य विशेषतः |
verses.iast:
satyam rākṣasarājendra śṛṇuṣva vacanam mama
rāmadāsasya dūtasya vānarasya viśeṣataḥ |
verses.translation: "O king of demons! Listen to my truthful words coming as it is from the lips of this servant of Rama, his messenger and particularly of this monkey."

glosses.meaning: (coming as it is) from the lips of a serpent of Rama

verses.devanagari:
सर्वान् लोकान् सुसम्हृत्य सभूतान् सचराचरान्
पुनरेव तथा स्रष्टुम् शक्तो रामो महायशाः |
verses.iast:
sarvān lokān susamhṛtya sabhūtān sacarācarān
punareva tathā sraṣṭum śakto rāmo mahāyaśāḥ |
verses.translation: "The renowned Rama is capable of totally destroying all the worlds together with its five elements, along with its animate and inanimate things and also to create yet again all the worlds in like manner as before."

glosses.meaning: along with its animate and inanimate things
and also to create in like manner as before

verses.devanagari:
देवासुरनरेन्द्रेषु यक्षरक्षोगणेषु च
विद्याधरेषु सर्वेषु गन्धर्वेषूरगेषु च |
सिद्धेषु किन्नरेन्द्रेषु पतत्रिषु च सर्वतः
सर्वभूतेषु सर्वत्र सर्वकालेषु नास्ति सः |
योरामम् प्रतियुध्येत विष्णुतुल्यपराक्रमम्
verses.iast:
devāsuranarendreṣu yakṣarakṣogaṇeṣu ca
vidyādhareṣu sarveṣu gandharveṣūrageṣu ca |
siddheṣu kinnarendreṣu patatriṣu ca sarvataḥ
sarvabhūteṣu sarvatra sarvakāleṣu nāsti saḥ |
yorāmam pratiyudhyeta viṣṇutulyaparākramam
verses.translation: "The renowned Rama, who is equal in prowess to Vishnu the lord of the preservation and among celestials, demons or the foremost of men, or among hordes of Yakshas the semi-divine beings or ogres or among all Vidyadharas, a king of super-natural beings or among Gandharvas the celestials musicians or among Uragas the semi-divine serpents or among Siddhas the holy personages having super-natural powers or among excellent Kinnaras the mythical beings with human figure and head of a horse or among all types of birds or among all living beings at all places and at all times."

glosses.meaning: who is equal in prowess to Vishnu the lord of preservation
among celestials or demons or the foremost of men
or among hordes of Yakshas the semi-divine beings or ogres
or among Gandharvas the celestial musicians
or among Uragas the semi-divine serpents
or among Siddhas the holy personages having super-natural powers
or among excellent Kinnaras the mythical beings with a human figure and the head of a horse

verses.devanagari:
सर्वलोकेश्वरस्यैवम् कृत्वा विप्रियमुत्तमम् |
रामस्य राजसिम्हस्य दुर्लभम् तव जीवितम्
verses.iast:
sarvalokeśvarasyaivam kṛtvā vipriyamuttamam |
rāmasya rājasimhasya durlabham tava jīvitam
verses.translation: "After doing a great harm in this manner to Rama the lord of all worlds as well as the lion among kings, your survival will be difficult."

glosses.meaning: the lord of all the worlds

verses.devanagari:
देवाश्च दैत्याश्च निशाचरेन्द्र |
गन्धर्वविद्याधरनागयक्षाः |
रामस्य लोकत्रयनायकस्य |
स्थातुम् न शक्ताः समरेषु सर्वे
verses.iast:
devāśca daityāśca niśācarendra |
gandharvavidyādharanāgayakṣāḥ |
rāmasya lokatrayanāyakasya |
sthātum na śaktāḥ samareṣu sarve
verses.translation: "O king of demons! Either celestials or demons or Gandharvas the celestial musicians or Vidyadharas a king of super-natural beings or Nagas the semi-divine serpents or Yakshas the semi divine beings-all of them are not able to stand before Rama the lord of the three worlds."

glosses.meaning: or Gandharvas the celestial musicians or Vidyadharas a king of super natural beings or Nagas the semi-divine serpents or Yaksha the semi-divine beings
the lord of the three worlds.

verses.devanagari:
ब्रह्म स्वयमुभूश्च तुराननो वा |
रुद्रस्त्रिणेत्रस्त्रिपुरान्तको वा |
इन्द्रो महेन्द्रः सुरनायको वा |
त्रातुम् न शक्ता युधि रामवध्यम्
verses.iast:
brahma svayamubhūśca turānano vā |
rudrastriṇetrastripurāntako vā |
indro mahendraḥ suranāyako vā |
trātum na śaktā yudhi rāmavadhyam
verses.translation: "Either Brahma the self-existing god with four faces or Rudra with three eyes and the destroyer of Tripura (the city built of gold, silver and iron in the sky, air and earth, by Maya for the demons and burnt by Shiva), or Mahendra the god of atmosphere and sky as also the lord of celestials would not be able to protect the one to be killed by Rama in battle."

glosses.meaning: the god of atmosphere and sky
the one to be killed by Rama

verses.devanagari:
स सौष्ठव उपेतम् अदीन वादिनः |
कपेः निशम्य अप्रतिमो अप्रियम् वचः |
दश आननः कोप विवृत्त लोचनः |
समादिशत् तस्य वधम् महाकपेः
verses.iast:
sa sauṣṭhava upetam adīna vādinaḥ |
kapeḥ niśamya apratimo apriyam vacaḥ |
daśa ānanaḥ kopa vivṛtta locanaḥ |
samādiśat tasya vadham mahākapeḥ
verses.translation: Hearing those unpleasant words endowed with extreme skillfulness and which were spoken without fear from Hanuma, that unequalled Ravana ordered for the killing of that Hanuma.
